name: degen_slice
title: Degenerate single-element slice In[k:k]
description: Three In[k:k] slices (a range whose endpoints coincide selects one bit) reorder a 3-bit input through buffers: Out_1_=In bit3, Out_2_=In bit1, Out_3_=In bit2. Pins In[k:k] as a legal one-wide slice.
